item.title: Help in statistics
item.description: I am currently in a college program, Bachelor in Psychology, and I am having to retake a statistics class! I am SO lost. It is definitely not what I expected and I am struggling. I am almost willing to pay someone to complete the class for me! It is a 6 week course and I am over a week behind, I completed the first week. Any tips, suggestions, resources… or any one smart looking to make some extra money?!
